sources.title: AETHORIA-AI/TR-HASH-MoE-200M-160B-Refinement · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model summary Same architecture as the base checkpoint: 201.2M parameters, 16 transformer layers, GQA (14 query heads / 2 KV heads), deterministic token-ID routed TR-Hash MoE (4 stored experts, top-2 active), tied embeddings. See TR-HASH-MoE-200M-130B for the full architecture and base pretraining details.

sources.title: [New Model]: TR-HASH deterministic token-routed MoE #53286
sources.snippet: TR-HASH is a 201.2M-parameter decoder-only causal language model with 16 layers, GQA, tied embeddings, four stored experts, top-2 activation, and an always-on shared SwiGLU path. Unlike conventional sparse MoE models, expert selection is not produced by a learned router.

sources.title: Add native support for TR-HASH deterministic token-routed MoE #48193
sources.snippet: Model description We are the model authors and would like native Transformers support for TR-HASH MoE so the public checkpoint can load with AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained (...) without trust_remote_code=True.
